title: Creator Action Board
summary: YTIntel now turns competitor evidence into a practical next-video execution plan instead of stopping at analysis.
changes: Added a Creator Action Board after each video analysis so the research ends with a concrete next move.
Added a reuse-vs-change breakdown showing which proven mechanics are worth borrowing and which parts should stay original.
Added a hook target that turns the competitor hook evidence into a clear opening objective for your own video.
Added delivery and re-hook guidance so the plan tells you what the video must actually fulfil and where attention resets belong.
Added format-engine guidance to translate the winning structure into an original repeatable framework.
Added a pre-publish checklist plus a Copy action plan button for scripting, briefing an editor, or saving the plan elsewhere.
Kept GPT-5.6 Sol intelligence, evidence guardrails, v0.10.7 analyser fixes, and previous update history intact.
why_it_matters: The goal is to close the gap between research and execution: analyse a competitor, understand why it worked, then leave YTIntel with a usable plan for the next video rather than a report you still have to translate yourself.
